consequence.statement: Existing SecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update status.storedVersions before the later release that removes v1beta1 — doing nothing leaves objects still stored in v1beta1 going into that removal.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration (re-write all SecretStore objects) and update status.storedVersions to drop v1beta1 before upgrading to the later release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the secretstores.external-secrets.io CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1 (spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage: true → false between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0), so existing SecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update must be completed before a later release removes v1beta1.
